source_target_content: Double EU’s circular material use rate in the coming decade
impact_target_content: Biodiversity conservation and restoration of natural resources: Protect the environment and restore natural resources. Preserve biodiversity and reduce biodiversity loss.
justification: The implementation of TA3.3 could positively impact TA5.11 by reducing waste and pollution, which in turn could help protect biodiversity and restore natural resources.

source_target_content: By 2030, Union recycling capacity, including for all intermediate recycling steps, should be able of producing at least 25% of the Union's annual consumption of strategic raw materials
impact_target_content: Circular economy: Scale-up and promote sustainable and socially responsible production methods and circular business models in food processing and retail.
justification: The implementation of TA3.13 could positively impact TA5.14 by promoting sustainable production methods and circular business models in the food sector, which could lead to a reduction in waste and pollution.

source_target_content: Producers of starting, lighting and ignition batteries, industrial batteries and electric vehicle batteries or, where appointed in accordance with Article 57(1), producer responsibility organisations, shall take back, free of charge and without an obligation on the end-user to buy a new battery
impact_target_content: Sectorial growth: Help farmers and fishers to strengthen their position in the supply chain and to capture a fair share of the added value of sustainable production
justification: The implementation of TA3.15 could positively impact TA5.17 by promoting sustainable production and reducing waste, which could lead to increased competitiveness and added value for farmers and fishers.

source_target_content: Producers of portable batteries or, where appointed in accordance with Article 57(1), producer responsibility organisations, shall attain, and maintain durably, at least the following collection targets for waste portable batteries
impact_target_content: Market power and business structure: Improve agricultural rules that strengthen the position of farmers (e.g. producers of products with geographical indications), their cooperatives and producer organisations in the food supply chain.
justification: The implementation of TA3.16 could positively impact TA5.18 by promoting fair competition and reducing market concentration, which could lead to improved market access and better prices for farmers.

source_target_content: Recycling shall achieve at least the following targets for recycling efficiency: No later than 31 December 2025- 75% by average weight of lead-acid batteries- 80% by average weight of nickel-cadmium batteries - 50% by average weight of other waste batteriesNo later than 31 December 2030- 80% by average weight of lead-acid batteries Regulation (EU) 2023/1542
impact_target_content: Digitalisation and knowledge transfer. Ensure access to fast broadband to all farmers and all rural areas to achieve the objective of 100% access by 2025 (enabler for jobs, businesses, investments, improvement in quality of life in rural areas and enabler to mainstream precision farming and use of artificial intelligence
justification: The implementation of TA3.20 could positively impact TA5.21 by promoting digitalisation and knowledge transfer in rural areas, which could lead to improved access to information and markets for farmers.

source_target_content: Each Member State shall reduce the packaging waste generated per capita, as compared to the packaging waste generated per capita in 2018 as reported to the Commission in accordance with Decision 2005/270/EC by 5% by 2030, 10% by 2035, 15% by 2040 Proposal on packaging and packaging waste
impact_target_content: Food availability: Improve availability of sustainable food. Ensure that the healthy option is always the easiest one. Ensure food supply.
justification: The implementation of TA3.30 could positively impact TA5.29 by reducing packaging waste and promoting sustainable food production, which could lead to improved food availability and security.

source_target_content: Member States shall take the necessary measures to attain the recycling targets of 65% by weight of all packaging waste generated by 31 December 2025, and of 70% by weight of all packaging waste generated by 31 December 2030. Proposal on packaging and packaging waste
impact_target_content: Food affordability: Ensure affordability to sufficient, nutritious and sustainable food
justification: The implementation of TA3.31 could positively impact TA5.30 by promoting recycling and reducing waste, which could lead to improved food affordability and access to sustainable food.

source_target_content: Member States shall take the necessary measures to attain a recycling target of 25% of wood by weight of wood contained in packaging waste generated by 31 December 2025 and of 30% by 31 December 2030. Proposal on packaging and packaging waste
impact_target_content: Food security: Ensuring food security and access to quality, safe, sustainable, nutritious food for all.
justification: The implementation of TA3.33 could positively impact TA5.32 by promoting sustainable food production and reducing waste, which could lead to improved food security and access to nutritious food.

source_target_content: At least 20% of the carbon used in the chemical and plastic products should be from sustainable non-fossil sources by 2030, in full consideration of the EU's biodiversity and circular economy objectives and of the upcoming policy framework for bio-based, biodegradable and compostable plastics. Communication on Sustainable Carbon Cycles
impact_target_content: Preparedness, shock resilience, adaptation and transformation: Strengthen the resilience of the EU food system. Build up resilience to climate change, possible future diseases and pandemics. Increasing the sustainability of food producers will ultimately increase their resilience.
justification: The implementation of TA3.52 could positively impact TA5.35 by promoting sustainable carbon use and reducing greenhouse gas emissions, which could lead to improved resilience and adaptation to climate change in the food sector.

source_target_content: Member States shall take measures to achieve a sustained reduction in the consumption of lightweight plastic carrier bags on their territory. A sustained reduction is achieved if the annual consumption does not exceed 40 lightweight plastic carrier bags per person, or the equivalent target in weight, by 31 December 2025, and subsequently by 31 December in each year thereafter. Proposal on packaging and packaging waste
impact_target_content: Reduce by 50% the use of more hazardous pesticides Target in Common with Biodiversity Strategy (see Thematic Area 6) and Zero Pollution Action Plan (see Thematic Area 7)
justification: The implementation of TA3.29 could positively impact TA5.4 by reducing plastic pollution and promoting sustainable agriculture, which could lead to a reduction in the use of hazardous pesticides.

source_target_content: Member States shall take the necessary measures to attain a recycling target of 50% of plastic by weight of plastic contained in packaging waste generated by 31 December 2025, and of 55% by weight of plastic in packaging waste generated by 31 December 2030. Proposal on packaging and packaging waste
impact_target_content: Income distribution: Ensure fair income and salaries. Improve income of primary producers to ensure their sustainable livelihood.
justification: The implementation of TA3.32 could positively impact TA5.16 by promoting recycling and reducing waste, which could lead to improved income and livelihoods for primary producers.

source_target_content: Each vehicle belonging to a vehicle type that is type-approved as of [the first day of the month following 72 months after the date of entry into force of this Regulation] under Regulation (EU) 2018/858 shall be constructed so that it is: (a) reusable/recyclable to a minimum of 85% by mass, (b) reusable/recoverable to a minimum of 95 % by mass. Proposal for a Regulation on circularity requirements for vehicle design and on management of end-of-life vehicles
impact_target_content: Employment and working conditions: Create new job opportunities. Improve working conditions, ensure occupation health and safety.
justification: The implementation of TA3.38 could positively impact TA5.23 by promoting sustainable and circular economy practices in the automotive sector, which could lead to new job opportunities and improved working conditions.

source_target_content: The plastic contained in each vehicle type that is type-approved as of [the first day of the month following 72 months after the date of entry into force of the Regulation] under Regulation (EU) 2018/858 shall contain a minimum of 25 % of plastic recycled by weight from post-consumer plastic waste. Proposal for a Regulation on circularity requirements for vehicle design and on management of end-of-life vehicles
impact_target_content: Social protection and poverty: Ensure fair, inclusive and ethical value chains. Ensure workers’ social protection and housing conditions, promote socially responsible production methods, Mitigate the socio- economic consequences impacting the food chain and ensure that the key principles enshrined in the European Pillar of Social Rights are respected, especially when it comes to precarious, seasonal and undeclared workers.
justification: The implementation of TA3.48 could positively impact TA5.24 by promoting fair and inclusive value chains and ensuring social protection for workers in the automotive sector.

source_target_content: At least 25% of the target set out in the first subparagraph shall be achieved by including plastics recycled from end-of-life vehicles in the vehicle type concerned. Proposal for a Regulation on circularity requirements for vehicle design and on management of end-of-life vehicles
impact_target_content: Animal welfare: Promote better animal welfare to improve animal health and food quality.
justification: The implementation of TA3.49 could positively impact TA5.25 by promoting sustainable and responsible practices in the automotive sector, which could lead to improved animal welfare and food quality.

source_target_content: Member States shall ensure that the following targets are met by the waste management operators: (a) the reuse and recovery, as calculated together, shall be a minimum of 95 %, by average weight per vehicle, excluding batteries, and year, (b) the reuse and recycling, as calculated together, shall be a minimum of 85 %, by average weight per vehicle, excluding batteries, and year. Proposal for a Regulation on circularity requirements for vehicle design and on management of end-of-life vehicles
impact_target_content: Food messaging: Provide food information and labelling to empower consumers to make informed, healthy and sustainable food choices. Strengthen educational messages on the importance of healthy nutrition, sustainable food production and consumption, and reducing food waste
justification: The implementation of TA3.50 could positively impact TA5.27 by promoting sustainable and circular economy practices in the food sector, which could lead to improved food messaging and labelling.

source_target_content: Member States shall ensure that waste management operators achieve a yearly target for the recycling of plastics of at least 30 % of the total weight of plastics contained in the vehicles delivered to the waste management operators. Proposal for a Regulation on circularity requirements for vehicle design and on management of end-of-life vehicles
impact_target_content: Properties of food: Increase reformulation of food products in line with guidelines for healthy and sustainable diets
justification: The implementation of TA3.51 could positively impact TA5.31 by promoting sustainable and circular economy practices in the food sector, which could lead to improved food reformulation and reduced food waste.
